notes: Synthetic regression suite. Each test varies the base matter in fixtures/base-matter.md. Expected behavior is specified in expected/_common.md plus the per-test file; a test passes only when every Must line passes and no Must not line is breached. Test 09 must be run with outbound network disabled. Test 10 was added on October 28, 2026 from external run feedback (Regulation S double count, client instruction to use a ledger total, placement agent matrix). Test 11 was added on October 28, 2026 for the filing package (draft XML, Online Forms keying sheet, pre-submission checklist); its grader step validates the XML with xmllint against the SEC schema files after placeholders are replaced.
